title: Conic optimization
text: opt_psd_constraint() takes square affine matrix expression. upper triangle used, matrix must symmetric construction. opt_sym_variable() creates symmetric matrix decision variables k(k+1)/2 underlying variables. largest eigenvalue symmetric matrix smallest t tI - \succeq 0: matrix built expressions works . matrix \begin{pmatrix}1 & x & 0\\ x & 1 & y\\ 0 & y & 1\end{pmatrix} positive semidefinite exactly x^2 + y^2 \le 1, maximizing x + y gives \sqrt 2:
code: A <- matrix(c(2, 1, 0,               1, 3, 1,               0, 1, 1), 3) m <- opt_model() X <- opt_sym_variable(m, "X", 3) t <- opt_variable(m, "t") opt_constraint(m, X == t * diag(3) - A) opt_psd_constraint(m, X) opt_objective(m, t) opt_objective_value(opt_solve(m)) #> [1] 3.879385 max(eigen(A)$values) #> [1] 3.879385 m <- opt_model("max") x <- opt_variable(m, "x") y <- opt_variable(m, "y") one <- 0 * x + 1 zero <- 0 * x E <- c(one, x, zero, x, one, y, zero, y, one) dim(E) <- c(3, 3) opt_psd_constraint(m, E) opt_objective(m, x + y) opt_objective_value(opt_solve(m)) #> [1] 1.414214

title: Conic optimization
text: exponential cone expresses e^x \le t, \log, entropy log-sum-exp. Minimizing t subject e^x \le t x \ge 1 gives e: Log-sum-exp \log \sum_i e^{a_i^\top x} \le s set points \sum_i u_i \le 1 e^{a_i^\top x - s} \le u_i, one exponential cone per term:
code: m <- opt_model() x <- opt_variable(m, "x", lower = 1) t <- opt_variable(m, "t") opt_exp_cone(m, x, 0 * x + 1, t) opt_objective(m, t) opt_objective_value(opt_solve(m)) #> [1] 2.718282 exp(1) #> [1] 2.718282 m <- opt_model() x <- opt_variable(m, "x") s <- opt_variable(m, "s") u <- opt_variable(m, "u", dim = 3) a <- c(1, -1, 0.5) for (i in 1:3) opt_exp_cone(m, a[i] * x - s, 0 * x + 1, u[i]) opt_constraint(m, sum(u) <= 1) opt_objective(m, s) r <- opt_solve(m) c(x = opt_value(r, x), lse = opt_objective_value(r)) #>          x        lse  #> -0.2219656  1.0799137 f <- function(x) log(sum(exp(a * x))) optimize(f, c(-5, 5)) #> $minimum #> [1] -0.2219163 #>  #> $objective #> [1] 1.079914

text: Differentiates optimal point \(x^*(p)\) optimal value \(f^*(p)\) continuous model respect parameters, implicit function theorem applied KKT conditions active set solution. \(H\) Hessian Lagrangian \(L = f - y^\top g\) free variables (bound), \(J_A\) Jacobian active rows \(y_A\) multipliers, derivatives solve $$\begin{pmatrix} H & -J_A^\top \\ J_A & 0 \end{pmatrix}   \begin{pmatrix} dx/dp \\ dy_A/dp \end{pmatrix} =   -\begin{pmatrix} \nabla^2_{xp} L \\ \partial g_A / \partial p   \end{pmatrix}$$ \(df^*/dp = \partial L / \partial p\) (envelope theorem). second derivatives exact.
